key_terms: Graphical representation: Linear equations represent straight lines; systems are solved by finding intersection points.
Consistency conditions via coefficient ratios a1/a2, b1/b2, c1/c2:
1. Intersecting lines (a1/a2 != b1/b2): Unique solution, system is consistent.
2. Coincident lines (a1/a2 = b1/b2 = c1/c2): Infinitely many solutions, system is dependent and consistent.
3. Parallel lines (a1/a2 = b1/b2 != c1/c2): No solution, system is inconsistent.
Substitution method: Expressing one variable in terms of the other and substituting into the remaining equation.
Elimination method: Multiplying equations by non-zero constants to equalize coefficients of one variable and eliminate it through addition or subtraction.
